official.deadline_central_display: 10 January - 20 February (annual window; the 2026 round closed on 20 February 2026)
official.deadline_note: The 2026 application period ran 10 January to 20 February 2026 and has closed. The awarding body states that applications are received between 10 January and 20 February every year, so the next window is expected to open on 10 January 2027, but no 2027 announcement has been published yet.
official.status_note: The 2026 application period ran 10 January to 20 February 2026 and has closed; the awarding body states that the 10 January - 20 February window recurs every year.
official.tuition_coverage_note: The announcement states the scholarship covers 'tuition fees'; the joint scholarship programmes page repeats 'tuition fees' among the covered items.
eligibility: Successful international students from IsDB member countries, and students from Muslim communities around the world living outside IsDB member countries
Minimum academic achievement of 70% for associate and bachelor's degree candidates
Minimum academic achievement of 75% for graduate candidates
Minimum academic achievement of 90% for candidates of Health Sciences (Medicine, Dentistry and Pharmacy)
Under 21 years of age for associate and bachelor's degree programmes, under 30 for master's programmes, under 35 for PhD programmes
Not a Turkish citizen and not a person who has lost Turkish citizenship, and not currently enrolled in a programme at a Turkish university at the level of education applied for
requirements: Apply only through the Türkiye Scholarships official website
Select 'Yes' under the 'Joint Scholarship Programs' section on the application screen in order to be considered for the joint programme
Choose a programme and department from the published list of eligible fields of study and countries for the IsDB programme
Meet the minimum academic achievement and age criteria for the level applied for
documents: A valid identity document, ID card or passport
A photograph of the candidate taken within the last 1 year
International exam results (GRE, GMAT, SAT, etc.) if required by the chosen university or programme
International language test results such as TOEFL or DELF if required by the chosen university or programme
A proposal for a research topic and a written example of research carried out (only for PhD applications)
selection_criteria: Academic achievement thresholds: 70% for associate and bachelor's candidates, 75% for graduate candidates, 90% for Health Sciences candidates
Alignment of the chosen field with the Sustainable Development Goals

Selection through the Türkiye Scholarships evaluation and selection process, with candidates restricted to the published list of eligible departments, universities and countries for the joint programme
application_method: Register and apply online through the Türkiye Scholarships Application System (TBBS) at tbbs.turkiyeburslari.gov.tr
Select 'Yes' under the 'Joint Scholarship Programs' section on the application screen
Choose an eligible programme, department and country from the published list for the IsDB joint programme
Upload all required documents and submit the application within the published window
official.application_route: Apply online through the Türkiye Scholarships application system only, answering 'Yes' under Joint Scholarship Programs; there is no separate IsDB application form.
official.citizenship_residency: Open to successful international students from IsDB member countries and to students from Muslim communities living in other countries; Turkish citizens and individuals who have lost Turkish citizenship are ineligible.
official.international_eligibility: International students only; the programme is designed for students from IsDB member countries and Muslim communities in other countries.
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Candidates must choose from the published list of eligible fields of study and countries for the IsDB joint programme, issued as separate lists for associate, bachelor's, master's and PhD levels; the programme supports promising students in fields aligned with the Sustainable Development Goals.
official.research_requirement: PhD applicants must upload a proposal for a research topic and a written example of research they have carried out.
official.description: The Türkiye Scholarships - IsDB Joint Scholarship Program is co-funded by the Presidency for Turks Abroad and Related Communities (YTB) and the Islamic Development Bank (IsDB) to enable high-achieving students from IsDB member countries and Muslim communities living in other countries to receive education at internationally recognized standards at prestigious universities in Türkiye, at associate, bachelor's, master's and PhD level.
official.program_type: Government-funded bilateral scholarship for developing countries, co-funded with the Islamic Development Bank

not_confirmed: funding_amount, funding_currency and funding_period - the IsDB announcement and joint programme page list the covered items but publish no stipend figure
verification.notes: Coverage items, the 10 January - 20 February 2026 application window, the repayment rule, academic and age criteria and the required documents were read from the awarding body's own announcement, joint scholarship programmes, criteria and application-steps pages.

applicant_utility.summary: There is no separate IsDB application: you file one ordinary Türkiye Scholarships application and switch on the joint programme by answering 'Yes' in the Joint Scholarship Programs section, so the ordinary academic and age bars apply. Your choices are confined to the departments, universities and countries on the IsDB list, published as a separate PDF per level, so check that list before you build your preferences. At associate and bachelor's level the support is repayable to the IsDB Education Trust after graduation and employment, so treat the master's and PhD routes as the grant-funded ones.
applicant_utility.best_fit: High-achieving students from IsDB member countries, or from Muslim communities in other countries, who want a fully serviced package (tuition, accommodation, stipend, insurance, a Turkish year and flights) at a Turkish university and who are under the age cap for their level.
application_readiness_checklist: Download the IsDB list of eligible departments, universities and countries for your level and shortlist only from that list
Check your age against the cap for your level - under 21 for associate and bachelor's, under 30 for master's, under 35 for PhD - as these are measured at application
Confirm your percentage meets the threshold for your level, including the 90% bar for Health Sciences (Medicine, Dentistry and Pharmacy)
Prepare documents in advance: diploma or temporary graduation certificate, transcript, identity document, and a photograph taken within the last year
For PhD, draft the research topic proposal and a written example of research you have carried out before the window opens
Check the language of instruction for your chosen programme, because English-medium programmes require an internationally accepted language certificate
common_rejection_risks: Being a Turkish citizen or having lost Turkish citizenship - an absolute bar
Already being enrolled at a Turkish university at the level of education you are applying for
Forgetting to answer 'Yes' under Joint Scholarship Programs, which silently removes you from the IsDB pool
Choosing a department, university or country that is not on the IsDB list for your level
Falling below the level-specific percentage, especially the 90% bar for Health Sciences
Submitting after 20 February - the window does not reopen mid-year
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Visa and residence permit costs, personal travel beyond the single round-trip ticket, and any living costs above the stipend, since the programme's own pages do not quantify the stipend.
document_audit: National exam results are only needed if you have them; international qualifications such as SAT must meet the secondary-school completion minimums the awarding body lists
GRE, GMAT or SAT results are only required where the chosen university or programme demands them, so check the department page first
TOEFL or equivalent language results are only required where the chosen programme is taught in English or another language - confirm the language of instruction in the application system
Only PhD applicants need the research proposal and written research example; preparing them at other levels wastes effort

Every awardee without a C1 Turkish proficiency certificate, including those placed in English-medium programmes, must complete the one-year Turkish language course and reach C1 by the end of the first academic year
alerts: The 2026 round closed on 20 February 2026 - the window reopens around 10 January each year, so do not plan around a rolling deadline
At associate and bachelor's level the support is a loan repaid to the IsDB Education Trust in easy instalments after graduation and employment
It is a single Türkiye Scholarships application, so you compete inside one system for both the general and the joint programme
Only the departments and countries on the IsDB list are open to you - a strong CV for an unlisted department does not help
The programme's stipend is not published on its own pages, so model your budget on cost of living in Türkiye rather than on an advertised figure
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Register on TBBS, complete one application, answer 'Yes' under Joint Scholarship Programs, choose from the IsDB list, upload documents and submit before 20 February; results follow the Türkiye Scholarships selection calendar.
